_comment: Routine names supported by evidence, applied by tools/disasm_all.py. Key 'BB:AAAA'. A name describes what the routine provably does (read from its instructions, or confirmed on the emulator) and never a guessed game purpose. 'note' gives inputs and outputs. The address name (Func_BBB_AAAA) is kept as an alias label. Evidence ids refer to docs/EVIDENCE_LOG.md; 'reading' means a complete static reading of the routine's instructions (E-0022).

00:000E.name: JumpToHL
00:000E.note: jp hl; the call target used by CallInBank

00:0080.name: InstallOamDmaRoutine
00:0080.note: copies the 10 bytes at $008E (ld a,$C0 / ldh [rDMA],a / wait / ret) to HRAM at $FF80

00:0949.name: FillBytes
00:0949.note: A = value, HL = destination, BC = count; HL ends past the last byte (memset)

00:0952.name: CopyBytes
00:0952.note: HL = source, DE = destination, BC = count (memcpy)

00:095B.name: NextTableByte
00:095B.note: wC5E8 = (wC5E8 + 1) & $7F; wC5E7 = the byte at $0973 + wC5E8

00:05D1.name: SpinDelay
00:05D1.note: returns at once if wC524 is zero, otherwise counts DE from $1B58 to 0 with three nops per step

00:120A.name: WaitForVRAMAccess
00:120A.note: loops until STAT bit 1 is clear (modes 0 and 1); returns with Z set

00:1211.name: WriteVRAMByte
00:1211.note: A = value, HL = address; disables interrupts, waits until VRAM is accessible, stores A at [HL]; clobbers hFFD1

00:121F.name: WriteVRAMByteInc
00:121F.note: like WriteVRAMByte but stores at [HL] and increments HL

00:1682.name: Multiply8
00:1682.note: HL = A * C (8 x 8 bit); clobbers A, B and C

00:16D1.name: DivideHLByA
00:16D1.note: HL = HL / A (quotient in HL), A = remainder; clobbers D, E

00:16F5.name: HLToDecimalDigits
00:16F5.note: HL (0-999) becomes three digits: wC8C0 = hundreds, wC8C1 = tens, wC8C2 = ones

00:181B.name: TestFlagBit
00:181B.note: DE = bit number; tests that bit of the bit array at wCBD7 (bit 0 of the first byte first); returns carry set when it is 1, A = 0 and carry clear otherwise; no range check

00:1845.name: SetFlagBit
00:1845.note: DE = bit number; sets that bit of the bit array at wCBD7; does nothing when DE >= $0300

00:1872.name: ReadByteInBank
00:1872.note: B = ROM bank, DE = address; C = the byte at [DE] in that bank; the caller's bank is restored

00:1F80.name: LoadSRAMRecordByte
00:1F80.note: A = record, C = offset; hFFC6 = the byte at sA000 + A * $A5 + C; HL preserved

00:1F89.name: LoadSRAMRecordWord
00:1F89.note: like LoadSRAMRecordByte but loads the word into hFFC6 (low) and hFFC7 (high)

00:1FD1.name: SRAMRecordAddress
00:1FD1.note: A = record, C = offset; HL = sA000 + A * $A5 + C (records are $A5 bytes)

00:290E.name: FillTilesFromRequest
00:290E.note: fills a block of tiles at wC52D/wC52E with the 16-byte pattern at $2940: width wC52F, height wC530 tiles (each byte waits for VRAM access); returns at once if either is zero

00:2E98.name: FillTilesRequest
00:2E98.note: HL = destination, DE = size (E = width, D = height); stores them and calls FillTilesFromRequest

00:3E7A.name: CompareHLToBC
00:3E7A.note: Z set when HL == BC; A is clobbered

00:3F25.name: AddAx9ToHL
00:3F25.note: HL += (A * 9) & $FF (the product is computed in 8 bits and wraps); A is clobbered, other registers preserved

13:4001.name: SetRequestPtrC921_B13
13:4001.note: HL is stored in wC921 (low) and wC922 (high); then wC5DC = 1, wC920 = 9, wC91F = 1, wC923 = 0 and wC919 = 0 (an earlier store of $80 to wC919 is overwritten)

04:55BB.name: SetRequestPtrC921_B04
04:55BB.note: HL is stored in wC921 (low) and wC922 (high); then wC5DC = 1, wC920 = 9, wC91F = 1, wC923 = 0 and wC919 = 0 (an earlier store of $80 to wC919 is overwritten)

13:4049.name: SetRequestPtrC91A_B13
13:4049.note: HL is stored in wC91A (low) and wC91B (high); then wC919 = $80 and wC5DC = 1

04:5603.name: SetRequestPtrC91A_B04
04:5603.note: HL is stored in wC91A (low) and wC91B (high); then wC919 = $80 and wC5DC = 1

0F:7F68.name: StoreHLInWC924_B0F
0F:7F68.note: HL is stored in wC924 (low) and wC925 (high); then wC926 = 0

73:4ED8.name: StoreHLInWC924_B73
73:4ED8.note: HL is stored in wC924 (low) and wC925 (high); then wC926 = 0

85:57C8.name: StoreHLInWC924_B85
85:57C8.note: HL is stored in wC924 (low) and wC925 (high); then wC926 = 0

73:7AA5.name: StoreHLInWC924_B73b
73:7AA5.note: HL is stored in wC924 (low) and wC925 (high); then wC926 = 0

04:55DF.name: SetRequestPtrC924FromDE_B04
04:55DF.note: DE is stored in wC924 (low) and wC925 (high); then wC5DC = 1, wC920 = $0A, wC91F = 1, wC923 = 0 and wC919 = 0 (an earlier store of $80 is overwritten)

13:4025.name: SetRequestPtrC924FromDE_B13
13:4025.note: DE is stored in wC924 (low) and wC925 (high); then wC5DC = 1, wC920 = $0A, wC91F = 1, wC923 = 0 and wC919 = 0 (an earlier store of $80 is overwritten)

0F:7ECE.name: SetBit2AtHL_B0F
0F:7ECE.note: sets bit 2 of the byte at [HL]; only A is clobbered

73:7A47.name: SetBit2AtHL_B73
73:7A47.note: sets bit 2 of the byte at [HL]; only A is clobbered

12:65F5.name: SetBit2AtHL_B12
12:65F5.note: sets bit 2 of the byte at [HL]; only A is clobbered

00:3E54.name: CarryUnlessWDA63SlotEmpty
00:3E54.note: A = slot number; returns with carry clear only when A < 8 and wDA63[A] is zero (carry set for A >= 8, for $FF and for any other non-zero value); A, BC and HL are preserved
